title: Reduction of clinical complaints and shortening of the period of incapacity for work in cases of ankle sprain treated on an outpatient basis with a standard orthosis and additional knee socks of compression class I
summary: Patients with ankle sprain that requires conservative treatment and was caused by an insured work accident should be included in the study. In addition to the standard therapy with an orthosis, a randomized additional knee-length compression therapy is carried out. The subjective and clinical course of the ankle sprain is examined over 3 months.
conditions: Sprain and strain of the upper ankle joint: part not specified

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Period from day of accident to presentation INZ <3d
- Age over 18 years and under 70
- existing employment
- BMI less than 35 kg/m²
- include the affected leg (if necessary, check on the healthy one).  
  Series stocking available
-occupational accident
Exclusion criteria:
previous injuries/surgery on the same ankle 
- additional injuries to the leg sustained in the accident or injury that further limits mobility
- hospitalization due to the ankle injury, 
- orthopedic or neurological leg diseases that limit mobility
- Neuropathy
- Evidence of an ankle joint injury that could be treated in an inpatient setting during the course of the study
